breakdown.description: The wall is described as two layers in series but also treated as parallel heat-flow paths; two layers in series should be analyzed as series thermal resistances; series and parallel conduction models are mutually exclusive.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the two layers as series thermal resistances throughout. It explicitly states 'heat flows through Layer 1 then Layer 2,' calculates individual resistances R1 and R2, sums them as R_total = R1 + R2 (series combination), and uses that total resistance to compute Q. There is no mention of parallel heat-flow paths, fully aligning with the ground truth prompt which describes the layers as being in series.
